blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan’s statement about the use of force, which was viewed by Philippine government officials as a threat, was not merely his personal opinion but reflected the position of the Chinese government. “They act very deliberately. Hindi pag-uugali ng ambasador ’yan, pag-uugali ng gobyerno nila ’yan (That’s not the ambassador’s conduct, that’s the conduct of their government,” Defense Secretary Gilberto “Gibo” Teodoro told reporters at the sidelines of the Senate hearing on the 2027 budget of the Department of National Defense (DND) and its attached agencies on Monday.
